title: Connection Replay Service Handover
summary: Recover the deployed contract from versioned handover artifacts and optimize its correct slow C++17 replay service.
taskPrompt: Start at input/README.md, resolve the deployed release from visible handover records, then optimize output/solution.cpp without changing results. Submit one C++17 source. Read deployment quotas and acceptance rules in the handover. Run bash run_tests.sh in output for public regressions.

inputFiles.name: handover
inputFiles.description: Release selection with referenced transport, ticket, archived contract and deployment records.

agentMustDo: Inspect the correct slow implementation and complete problem specification.
Optimize performance without changing exact results.
Save output/solution.cpp and verify relevant behavior.
evaluation: Compile the submitted source with GNU C++17 -O2 -pipe. Execute legal private inputs with 6-second wall and 512-MiB address-space limits. Compare all prefix answers as signed 64-bit integers. Groups A/B/C/D/E award 15/20/25/30/10 points only when every case in that group passes. Infrastructure failures raise errors and are not zero scores.
